title_en: Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Work of Civil Mediation by People's Courts

articles.content_en: Article 1 The People's Court may conduct mediation for civil cases of first instance, second instance, and retrial that it accepts after the expiration of the defense period and before the judgment is rendered. After obtaining the consent of all parties, the People's Court may conduct mediation before the expiration of the defense period.

Article 2 For civil cases that may possibly be resolved through mediation, the People's Court shall conduct mediation. However, the People's Court shall not conduct mediation for cases subject to special procedures, supervision procedures, public summons procedures, or bankruptcy and debt repayment procedures, cases concerning confirmation of marital relationship or status relationship, and other civil cases that cannot be mediated by their nature.

Article 3 In accordance with the provisions of Article 87 of the Civil Procedure Law, the People's Court may invite enterprises, institutions, social organizations, or other organizations that have a specific relationship with the parties or a certain connection with the case, and individuals who have specialized knowledge, specific social experience, a specific relationship with the parties, and are conducive to facilitating mediation to assist in the mediation work.
With the consent of all parties, the People's Court may entrust the units or individuals specified in the preceding paragraph to conduct mediation for the case. After a mediation agreement is reached, the People's Court shall confirm it according to law.

Article 4 If the parties reach a settlement agreement on their own during the proceedings, the People's Court may, upon the application of the parties, confirm the settlement agreement according to law and issue a mediation document. The period during which both parties apply for out-of-court settlement shall not be counted in the trial period.
If a party applies to the People's Court for coordination of the settlement activities during the settlement process, the People's Court may assign adjudicative assistants or invite or entrust relevant units or individuals to engage in coordination activities.

Article 5 The People's Court shall, before mediation, inform the parties of the names of the mediation presider and the court clerk, and the relevant litigation rights and obligations such as the right to apply for withdrawal.

Article 6 If the People's Court conducts mediation for a case before the expiration of the defense period, and a mediation agreement is not reached within 15 days from the date the parties agree to mediation for cases subject to ordinary procedures, or within 7 days from the date the parties agree to mediation for cases subject to summary procedures, with the consent of all parties, mediation may continue. The extended mediation period shall not be counted in the trial period.

Article 7 If a party applies for mediation to be conducted without public hearing, the People's Court shall permit it.
During mediation, all parties shall be present at the same time, and mediation work may also be conducted with each party separately as needed.
Article 8 The parties may propose a mediation plan on their own, and the person presiding over the mediation may also propose a mediation plan for the parties' reference during negotiation.
Article 9 If the content of a mediation agreement exceeds the litigation claims, the People's Court may permit it.

Article 10 If a mediation agreement stipulates that a party who fails to perform the agreement shall bear civil liability, the People's Court shall permit it.
If a mediation agreement contains a clause stipulating that if one party fails to perform the agreement, the other party may request the People's Court to render a judgment on the case, the People's Court shall not permit it.

Article 11 If a mediation agreement stipulates that one party provides a guarantee or a third party outside the case agrees to provide a guarantee for a party, the People's Court shall permit it.
If a third party outside the case provides a guarantee, the People's Court shall, when issuing a mediation document, list the guarantor and deliver the mediation document to the guarantor. The failure of the guarantor to sign for receipt of the mediation document shall not affect the effectiveness of the mediation document.
The guarantee provided by a party or a third party outside the case shall take effect when it meets the conditions specified in the Guarantee Law.

Article 13 In accordance with Article 90, paragraph 1, item (4) of the Civil Procedure Law, if all parties agree that the mediation agreement shall take effect after signature or seal, after the People's Court examines and confirms it, it shall be recorded in the transcript or attached to the case file, and shall have legal effect after being signed or sealed by the parties, the adjudicators, and the court clerk. If a party requests the issuance of a mediation document, the People's Court shall issue a mediation document and deliver it to the party. The refusal of a party to sign for receipt of the mediation document shall not affect the validity of the mediation agreement. If one party fails to perform the mediation agreement, the other party may apply to the People's Court for enforcement by presenting the mediation document.

Article 14 The failure of the parties to reach an agreement on how to bear the litigation costs shall not affect the validity of the mediation agreement. The People's Court may directly decide the proportion of litigation costs to be borne by the parties and record the decision in the mediation document.

Article 15 If a party who neither enjoys rights nor assumes obligations under the mediation document fails to sign for receipt of the mediation document, it shall not affect the validity of the mediation document.

Article 16 If a party raises an objection on the ground that the civil mediation document is inconsistent with the original intention of the mediation agreement, and the People's Court, after examination, considers the objection to be justified, it shall, in accordance with the mediation agreement, rule to supplement and correct the relevant contents of the civil mediation document.

Article 17 If the parties reach a mediation agreement on part of the litigation claims, the People's Court may confirm it in advance and issue a mediation document.
If the parties reach a mediation agreement on the main litigation claims, and request the People's Court to provide a handling opinion on the litigation claims that have not been agreed upon and express acceptance of that handling result, the handling opinion of the People's Court shall be part of the mediation agreement, and it shall be recorded in the mediation document if a mediation document is issued.

Article 18 If, after reaching a settlement agreement on their own or reaching an agreement through mediation, the parties request the People's Court to issue a judgment in accordance with the contents of the settlement agreement or the mediation agreement, the People's Court shall not support it.

Article 19 When the conditions of a guarantee clause or the conditions for bearing civil liability as specified in the mediation document are fulfilled, and a party applies for enforcement, the People's Court shall enforce according to law.
After a party who fails to perform the mediation agreement bears the civil liability specified in the mediation document in accordance with the preceding paragraph, if the other party further requests it to bear the liability for delayed performance as stipulated in Article 232 of the Civil Procedure Law, the People's Court shall not support it.

Article 20 If the mediation document stipulates the delivery of a specific subject matter, the real rights and priority rights of a third party that already exist on that subject matter before the mediation agreement is reached shall not be affected. If a third party raises an objection to the subject matter of enforcement during the enforcement process, it shall be handled in accordance with Article 208 of the Civil Procedure Law.
Article 21 The People's Court shall conduct mediation for cases of criminal incidental civil actions in accordance with these Provisions.

Article 22 For cases already accepted by the People's Court before these Provisions come into effect but not yet concluded after these Provisions come into force, they shall be handled in accordance with these Provisions.
Article 23 Where relevant judicial interpretations of the Supreme People's Court before these Provisions come into effect are inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall apply.
Article 24 These Provisions shall come into force as of November 1, 2004.
